g.text: RLS08 supply connector; observe current budget

g.desc: RLS08 supply connector; observe current budget

g.text: Power the RLS08 from J2 using a regulated external 5 V supply rated for its documented current. J2 ground is shared with Uno GND; keep external positive separate from Uno 5 V. Check output-high voltage and USB/board limits. Sensor is not physically tested.

g.desc: Power the RLS08 from J2 using a regulated external 5 V supply rated for its documented current. J2 ground is shared with Uno GND; keep external positive separate from Uno 5 V. Check output-high voltage and USB/board limits. Sensor is not physically tested.

g.text: J1 pins 1..6 are RLS08 digital outputs D1..D6 and connect to Uno D2..D7. Pins 7/8 connect to A0/A1 used as digital inputs. The firmware reports raw logic as bit 0..7.
